name: Migrate board and tasks to another project
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Implemented board/sprint export & import** — a portable JSON document carrying board config, columns and every task with full message history, with `kanban.js` store actions (`exportBoard`/`importBoard`) that adapt all project-bound fields (project/owner ids, parent/chat links, file paths, sprint membership) to the destination project.

2. **Fixed the dead Export/Import button** — `BoardTransferModal.vue` accessed `this.$storex` inside `data()`, where the globally-mixed computed isn't yet defined; moved the active-project fallback to a `created()` hook so the modal mounts correctly.

3. **Extended transfer options** — added "Copy to clipboard" export (via the shared `$storex.ui.copyTextToClipboard`), clipboard-paste import, and a new **Copy / Move to another project** tab backed by `copyBoardToProject`/`moveBoardToProject` (move deletes the source only after a successful copy).

4. **Fixed transient duplicate cards during migration** — cross-project chats saved during import emitted socket `chat_event`s that `onChatEvent`/`reloadChat` re-registered into the active-project-scoped chats store; added an `isActiveProjectChat` guard so foreign chats are never cached.

5. **Added board deletion** — a Danger-zone entry in the shared Board settings modal with a confirmation dialog; kanban boards can optionally delete their tasks (otherwise `board`/`column` are cleared and cards fall back to "No board"), while sprint tasks are always kept and only leave the sprint.

messages.content: Export/Import button is doing nothing when clicked

I'll investigate why the Transfer (Export/Import) button appears to do nothing. Let me explore the relevant components and the modal wiring. ``` Read 2 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/kanban/board/BoardTransferModal.vue, src/components/ProjectDetailt.vue ``` ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` Let me examine the global `Modal` component, `main.ts`, and the store registration to trace a possible render failure. ``` Read 3 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/Modal.vue, src/main.ts, src/store/index.js | Failed to read 1 file(s): src/store/index.ts ``` ``` Search completed: 3 queries executed, 30 documents found ``` I found a likely culprit. Let me confirm how other components initialize a `targetProject` from the store (and whether they avoid `this.$storex` inside `data()`). ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/vibe/ChatPanelHeader.vue ``` ``` Search completed: 3 queries executed, 30 documents found ``` ## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements** - Clicking the **Transfer** (Export/Import) button in the kanban toolbar or the sprint header must open the `BoardTransferModal`. - Right now the click has no visible effect. **Root Cause Found** In `BoardTransferModal.vue`, the import target project is initialized **inside `data()`**: ```js data() { return { ... targetProject: this.project || this.$storex.projects.activeProject } } ``` `this.$storex` is provided by the global mixin **as a computed property** (`src/main.ts` → `computed: { $storex () { return $storex } }`). In Vue 3's Options API the initialization order is **props → methods → data → computed → watch**. Computed properties are therefore **not defined yet while `data()` evaluates**, so `this.$storex` is `undefined` there. Since `KanbanBoardView` almost always passes `:project="project"` as `null` (the board view resolves its project from `$project`, not a prop), the expression evaluates `undefined.projects` and throws a `TypeError`. That throw happens while Vue creates the child component, so the modal is never mounted → **the button appears to do nothing** (the error only shows in the console). This is confirmed by the project's own established pattern in `ChatPanelHeader.vue`, which initializes `targetProject: null` in `data()` and resolves it from `$storex` later in a lifecycle hook (`mounted()` → `setTargetProject()`), never in `data()`. **Strategic Approach** - Keep `data()` free of any `this.$storex` access: initialize `targetProject` from the `project` prop only (`this.project || null`). - Resolve the fallback (`$storex.projects.activeProject`) in a `created()` hook, where computed properties are fully available. **Dependencies & Risks** - No change to the export/import logic, store actions, or template — only the initialization order of one data field. - `created()` runs after state/props/computed setup and before the first render, so the default project is available on first paint. - No other `this.$storex` (or any computed) usages exist inside `data()` in this file. **Target Files** - Modify: `src/components/kanban/board/BoardTransferModal.vue` ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach Single, focused fix in `BoardTransferModal.vue`: move the active-project fallback out of `data()` into a new `created()` hook. All other logic (export, import, file reading, download) is untouched. ## 3. File changes @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/components/kanban/board/BoardTransferModal.vue language: vue change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ @@ CODX_END @@ ## 4. File Change Summary Tables | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/kanban/board/BoardTransferModal.vue` | Modify | `data()` | Removed the `this.$storex.projects.activeProject` access from `data()` (computed not yet initialized → threw `TypeError`, aborting the component mount). Now initialized from the `project` prop only: `this.project \|\| null`. | | `src/components/kanban/board/BoardTransferModal.vue` | Modify | `created()` | New hook that resolves the fallback import target from `this.$storex.projects.activeProject` once computed properties are available. | ### Why the button was "doing nothing" 1. Clicking **Transfer** sets `showTransfer = true` in `KanbanBoardView` — the wiring was correct. 2. Vue then tries to mount `BoardTransferModal`; while evaluating its `data()`, `this.$storex` is `undefined` (it is a computed property that gets defined *after* `data()`), so `this.$storex.projects.activeProject` throws. 3. Vue catches/logs the error, the component never mounts, and no modal appears → the click looks like a no-op. Moving the store read to `created()` (where `$storex` is available, matching the project's `ChatPanelHeader.vue` pattern) fixes it. No other file needs to change. # Made with ❤️ by codx-junior

Summary of this conversation:

1. You requested the ability to export/import a board or sprint with all its info, adapting project-bound settings when importing into a different project.
2. I explored the kanban board components, stores (`kanban.js`, `chats.js`), and the `codx_path`-scoped API to understand the data model and cross-project feasibility.
3. I proposed a portable JSON export contract (`codx-junior-board`) containing board config, columns, source manifest, and every task with its full message history.
4. I implemented it across five files: added `importChat` to `chats.js`, `exportBoard`/`importBoard` plus path/id/project adaptation helpers to `kanban.js`, created `BoardTransferModal.vue`, and wired Transfer buttons into `KanbanBoardView.vue` and `SprintBoardView.vue`.
5. Import adapts `owner_project_id`/`project_id`, parent/chat links, absolute file paths, board/sprint membership, and clears `session_id` — all client-side with no backend changes.

1. **First request:** Enable exporting/importing a board/sprint (with all info) between projects, adapting project-bound settings on import.
2. **Solution delivered:** Added `exportBoard`/`importBoard` actions to the kanban store, an `importChat` action to the chats store, and a new accessible `BoardTransferModal.vue`.
3. **Wiring added:** "Transfer" buttons in `KanbanBoardView.vue` (kanban toolbar + sprint relay) and `SprintBoardView.vue` (header), plus id/path/project remapping helpers.
4. **Bug reported:** "Export/Import button is doing nothing when clicked."
5. **Bug fixed:** Root cause was `this.$storex` (a computed property) being accessed inside `data()` in `BoardTransferModal.vue` before computed props exist — threw a `TypeError` and prevented the modal from mounting; moved the fallback to a new `created()` hook (matching `ChatPanelHeader.vue`'s pattern).

1. We built board/sprint export & import (full task history) with project-aware adaptation of projects, links, paths, membership, and session ids.
2. The Transfer button appeared dead because `this.$storex` (a computed) was read inside `data()`; moving that read to `created()` fixed the modal mount.
3. We added "Copy to clipboard" export plus clipboard paste-import, reusing the app-wide clipboard helper.
4. We added **Copy** and **Move** to another project via new store actions `copyBoardToProject` / `moveBoardToProject` (move deletes the source only after a successful copy).
5. We scoped `chats.importChat` to the active project and guarded `onBoardImported`, so cross-project transfers never leak or delete tasks in the wrong project.

1. **Goal:** Export/import a kanban board or sprint — with all columns, tasks and full message history — and copy/move it between projects, adapting every project-bound setting.
2. **Delivered:** `exportBoard`/`importBoard` plus `copyBoardToProject`/`moveBoardToProject` store actions, a `BoardTransferModal.vue` (Export/Import/Copy-Move tabs, clipboard export & paste), and Transfer buttons in the kanban and sprint toolbars.
3. **Bug 1:** The Transfer button "did nothing" — `data()` read the computed `this.$storex`, which isn't available yet and threw; fixed by moving the active-project lookup into `created()`.
4. **Bug 2:** Exported cards duplicated in the current board during migration — backend `chat_event` broadcasts made `onChatEvent`/`reloadChat` cache foreign chats; fixed by scoping the chats store to the active project (`isActiveProjectChat`).
5. **Result:** Boards transfer cleanly between projects with no data loss, no card leakage, and instant UI feedback.
